verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no API documentation is cited. The llms.txt file is a product summary for LLMs, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
